tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2610 Basic HD IP Phone with Adapter is a carrier-grade VoIP desk phone designed for businesses, offices, call centers, and remote communication environments. Built with advanced HD audio technology, support for 2 SIP accounts, and a modern color LCD display, the GRP2610 delivers crystal-clear voice communication and enterprise-level reliability.


As part of Grandstream’s professional GRP series, the GRP2610 offers centralized management, zero-touch provisioning, and enhanced security features, making it an excellent choice for small and medium-sized businesses seeking a cost-effective and scalable IP telephony solution.


Buy the original Grandstream GRP2610 Basic HD IP Phone with Adapter from D CORE at the best price in Bangladesh and enjoy reliable VoIP communication with professional support.


Key Features


  • Supports 2 SIP accounts and 2 lines
  • 2.4-inch (320 x 240) TFT color LCD display
  • HD audio on handset and speakerphone
  • 5-way audio conferencing
  • Dual 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports
  • Electronic Hook Switch (EHS) support for compatible headsets
  • Noise Shield technology for minimizing background noise
  • Enterprise-grade security with secure boot and encrypted data storage
  • GDMS cloud provisioning and centralized management
  • Interchangeable faceplate for easy logo customization
  • Wall-mountable design
